name: Main house check-in
description: You can arrive from 11:00 and sit in the cocktail bar, then find your room by going to the reception.

name: Guests arrive
description: Meet everyone in the great hall and wonder over to find your seat in the orangery.

name: The ceremony
description: Martin & Ciera say their vows in front of their nearest and dearest.

name: Cocktails & canapés
description: Drinks, photographs and confetti in the Great Hall.

name: Wedding breakfast
description: A candlelit dinner followed by toasts and speeches.

name: First dance
description: Dancing till late with our favourite people.

name: Late night snack
description: Grab a slice of Pizza before getting back to the dance floor.

name: Bar closes
description: Buy your bottles and enjoy it by the Great Hall fire. No curfew, head upstairs when you're ready.

name: Breakfast
description: For everyone staying, a full english breakfast will be served in the Banquet Hall.

name: Checkout
description: Checkout your rooms, hopefully not still drunk. Safe drive home.
